rowan_csm: Heads-up — Slipstream renewal in ~5w. Saw a sudden ~78% drop in prod calls starting 2026-04-02. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/slipstream
usage-bot: ALERT: slipstream-prod volume -78% (24h). No 5xx increase; token spend down. Affected endpoints: /embed-batch, /rerank.
ana_sales: On the last commercial call they said they're trialing OrbitAI this month. Logged in SFDC.
liam_se: Support ticket shows client-side change: routing embeddings to an internal vector store on 2026-04-02. Attached config snippet.
rowan_csm: Sounds like partial migration + competitive trial. Proposed triage: quick health sync with ML lead, short cost vs performance brief, offer timeboxed dedicated credit, technical backstop workshop.
ana_sales: Sales prefers a 4-week credit and joint tech session. I'll draft the offer.
liam_se: Dev side: no infra deploys on 2026-04-02. KV hits steady. I'll prepare a small runbook to help revert client routing if needed. Available Wed 11am PT for the session.
devops-bot: Billing hold requires documented customer request + finance approval. Use /billing/hold-request.
tess_finance: We need written request + evidence of migration to approve holds. Will expedite review if provided.
rowan_csm: Actions: Ana — draft credit offer; Liam — runbook + tech deck; Rowan — cost brief; Ana will schedule sync and include pre-reads. Set renewal risk = "elevated" until sync.
